notes.title: Mobile release of Forward: Escape the Fold!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The past 48 hours have been very intense on my side but now the line is crossed and I can announce the launch of Forward: Escape the Fold to iOS & Android. It's so exciting for me :)

[b]You can download the game on iOS [u][url=https://apps.apple.com/en/app/forward-espace-the-fold/id1550498827]here[/url][/u][/b].

[b]You can download the game on Android [u][url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.twotinydice.forward]here[/url][/u][/b].

The purchase includes the full game (identical to the PC release) and is completely adapted to playing on mobile.

Hope you enjoy it!

Christophe

You can join the Two Tiny Dice Discord [url=https://discord.gg/UcycyJBZtG]here[/url].

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - Ultimate Edition now LIVE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's been a while since the game got updated - the waiting ends NOW!

This update brings all the content I really wanted to bring the game and that I couldn't include earlier. Without further ado, here are the update notes:

[list]
[*]1 NEW Character with 3 unique powers
[*]14 NEW items
[*]3 NEW Challenges
[*]1 NEW Status Recovery
[*]Some NEW secrets (I hope you find it!)
[*]a LOT of balancing from characters to items and powers
[/list]


This update signals the ultimate version of the game - meaning, I believe I have built the game I wanted to make and will be creating very little new content from this point onwards. I will happily fix the game if needed but will be focusing my attention on my next game!

In addition, as I discussed on DIscord, in the near future there will be a mobile port of the game! Keep your eyes peeled for that :)

Thank you to everyone who played the game and it was a brilliant adventure!

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 - New items, New Challenges & more
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.0 was launched on Sunday but there were some bugs found by the Discord community very quickly. So I implemented a hot-fix soon after which is update 1.1.1 - decided to stall the announcement to make sure there weren't any new issues discovered.

Now though I'm confident it's time for you guys to try it out for yourselves :) There's a lot of new stuff to try and I hope you'll enjoy trying out the new objects and challenges especially!

[b]Don't forget to join the game's [u][url=https://discord.gg/mynGNdqtmx][b]Discord[/b][/url][/u] to chat with other players and discuss proposals for the game!
[/b]
Here are some of the major changes to the game:

- 14 NEW items that will definitely switch things up during your runs
- 2 NEW challenges
- The Darkness challenge will now begin with 2 Gorgon Eyes 😵
- You can now leave corrupted chests for 5 HP (thought this would add some extra strategy!)
- Non-stackable items will no longer appear if you already have one in your inventory (no more frustration!!)
- Reworked items that trigger power (i.e rings)
- Removed feedback button

As for balancing changes:

- Increased the overall difficulty (I follow internally win rates to figure out the right balance)
- For Azerty, the Iron Block is now a stackable item
- For Phade, the Return power now leaves a sword card instead of a road card
- For Raven, the Armor power now costs 4 instead of 7 mana

In addition, I wanted to say I'm working on bigger patches for the next weeks/months with LOTS of new content, here are a few things I'm working on:

- Endless Mode - highly requested! I’m working on finding the right balance for this mode and how to make it worthwhile
- Draft Mode - where you would build an inventory at the beginning of the run and face the Fold with it. This might be a separate mode or a new character
- More achievements - why not right?
- A new level type where you can pick a new power
- and obviously, NEW characters!

Thank you for all the support and I can't wait to continue improving the game!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now use Space to trigger the power and skip story (if keyboard controls are enabled).
[*] Enemies can no longer appear on the last two rows before the boss.
[*] The visualization of the selected power is more explicit.
[/list]
[h2]Balancing:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Anubis] Rework Transmutation power.
[*] [Azerty] Iron block new gives 7 armor durability instead of 10.
[*] [Phade] Starts with 14 HP instead of 15 and 2 armor.
[*] [???] Tornado power makes more different cards appear.
[/list]
[h2]Bug fix:[/h2]
[list]
[*] “Increase in Power” now doubles values correctly.
[*] “Return” power with “power ring” could sometimes leave the path empty.
[*] The statuses are triggered correctly in the tuto and the “mini-levels”.
[*] Correction of (too many) spelling mistakes.
[/list]

notes.title: First Update - Fixing some player issues and some more balancing!
notes.notes:
First update since the release of the game. It adds few features and mostly fixes bugs and character balancing. I'll be making more of theses updates to keep the game balanced and will be adding more content soon!

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*]New item: Vitality Dagger
[*]New experimental setting allowing to right click on a card to move on it.
[*]New experimental setting allowing to use keyboard to move.
[*]Chests/stores no longer trigger statuses.
[*]Chests will always have different cards.
[*]Clearer pause menu buttons.
[*]Bosses always drop heart card.
[*]Statuses can no longer exceed 999.
[*]Personal best score at the end of the game.
[*]Rework “So close” achievement.
[*]New changelog screen.
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]

Phade:
[list]
[*]+3 HP
[*]Absorption now costs 5 instead of 6 and absorbs 3 health points instead of 2.
[/list]
Anubis:
[list]
[*]+1 HP
[/list]
Silence:
[list]
[*]Starts with an additional item: Vitality Dagger
[/list]
Azerty
[list]
[*]Starts with 24 armor instead of 20.
[*]Iron block item now gives 10 armor instead of 6.
[*]Beat the iron power now changes 4 random cards instead of 2.
[*]Repair power become Heart of steel with a totally different effect.
[/list]

[b]Bug fix[/b]
It was sometimes impossible to start a level (bug with the amber item and the immunity status).
Correction of (too many) spelling mistakes.

I have more exciting content on the way! All this feedback has been so motivating for me and I can't see myself stopping updating the game anytime soon :)

Christophe Coyard
